name: ai-insight-agent
description: Market Intelligence Agent — AI 行业市场洞察日报系统（单体 Agent + 模块化内部流程）

scripts.run: npm run build && node --experimental-sqlite dist/cli/index.js run
scripts.run:today: npm run build && node --experimental-sqlite dist/cli/index.js run --date "$(date +%F)"
scripts.dev: npm run build && node --experimental-sqlite --no-warnings dist/cli/index.js run
scripts.serve: npm run build && node --experimental-sqlite --no-warnings dist/cli/index.js serve
scripts.test: npm run build && node --experimental-sqlite --test dist/evaluator/*.test.js dist/collectors/*.test.js
